summary: A dense, modular worker-placement game where you juggle multiple types of astronauts and resources to build structures and fund corporation projects on a shared lunar base; the drafted shuttle tile each round dictates both your options and turn order, creating a tight tactical puzzle layered on top of a longer-term engine-building plan. With only three of seven corporations in play each game, the available resources, actions, and scoring paths shift substantially from one session to the next.
praised: high replayability from the modular corporation setup
clever shuttle-draft mechanism that ties resource access to turn order
satisfying, tight worker-placement puzzle with meaningful trade-offs each turn
strong production and thematic presentation of the lunar base
criticised: steep learning curve and heavy rules/iconography overhead
corporation combinations can feel imbalanced or swingy between games
prone to analysis paralysis, especially with four players
a lot to track for a fairly short (three-round) game

interaction.kind: worker placement blocking and area majority for base structures, mostly indirect competition for spots and resources

scoring.why: final score comes from structures built, projects funded, and area-majority control, with the exact mix varying by which three corporations were drafted into the game

similar: Merv: The Heart of the Silk Road
_name: Shackleton Base: A Journey to the Moon
